===Models=== Additional models are covered by the FCC certification:
Two models referred to as ''GE 4 PORT WiFi Gateway'' lack the GPON fiber connection :of the ''GPON 4 Port WiFi Gateway'' models. Models with ''26'' in model number lack 5GHz support of models with ''28'' in number.
===Specifications=== * ZNID-GPON-2426B1 • GPON Uplink, 2x POTS, 4x GigE, 1x USB port :2x2 2.4GHz 802.11bgn * ZNID-GPON-2428B1 • GPON Uplink, 2x POTS, 4x GigE, 1x USB port :2x2 2.4GHz 802.11bgn, 3x3 5.8GHz 802.11an/ac * ZNID-GE-2426B1 • GE Uplink, 2x POTS, 4x GigE, 1x USB port :2x2 2.4GHz 802.11bgn * ZNID-GE-2428B1 • GE Uplink, 2x POTS, 4x GigE, 1x USB port :2x2 2.4GHz 802.11bgn, 3x3 5.8GHz 802.11an/ac <!--Test Software "MTool_2.0.1.1" is mentioned in FCC docs"-->
